sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows micafungin is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
The product label for NDC 70771168301 identifies Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3013712903) as the registered manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1236639 at that plant ended 2024-04-23 and was classified OAI with 10 observations including absence of written procedures and validation lacking for sterile drug products.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2024-08-29.
Recall D-0596-2024 for micafungin for injection 100 mg/vial manufactured for Northstar Rx LLC was initiated 2024-07-02 and classified Class III for cross contamination with other products.
Par Health, USA LLC posted a discontinuation notice on 2026-09-11, which appears on FDA's shortage list as To Be Discontinued.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Baxter Healthcare Corporation, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
